prerequisites: Basic programming knowledge, familiarity with elementary concepts such as variables, control structures, functions, and simple data structures.
Basic HTML and CSS knowledge is recommended.

learning_outcomes.text: Students possess a fundamental understanding of current technologies used on the Internet.
Students are able to select and apply programs and frameworks for programming interactive web applications and apps.
Students are able to conceptualize and implement dynamic web applications.
Students can identify and apply technologies for programming web applications.
Students apply the acquired knowledge in the form of web applications.
Students solve detailed problems by experimenting with possible approaches and technical solutions.
Students independently create novel applications for the Internet, based on learned or self-created technologies.
Students develop teamwork and project management competencies within the framework of an extensive final project realized in small groups.
Students must jointly develop a complete conceptual and technical concept and meaningfully coordinate team tasks.
Students are able to create web applications on the computer and critically evaluate them with regard to societal requirements.

syllabus_topics: Introduction to PHP and PHP Frameworks
assessment_rules: The graded assessment is a written project report of approximately 10 pages, with an associated explanation of approximately 15 minutes. The ungraded assessment is experimental work consisting of approximately 5 experiments in total. Successful completion of these components is required for ECTS credit points.
